title: Momoi Airi — Even If Just With Words〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... We could make it a tournament, but with just four people it'll probably be over before we know it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means a free-for-all is the way to go. We could have five-minute rounds that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa, it's already this late?
Time flies when you're working on a stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, more importantly!
I've gotta get ready for that call...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... The link should be... Aha! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right in the nick of time. I'll join in now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry for setting up this call for so late...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That's okay. The two of us sort of have to squeeze in meetings like this when we can because of work.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <I'm also really busy between school and band practice... It's actually really nice to talk from home for a change.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Right. What do we need to do for our tea party?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah, we have a lot to prepare, but we'll need to start by making invitations for everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree. We're going through the trouble of holding a tea party, so we should make it feel like one.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Still, making nice-looking invitations from scratch sounds really hard...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Not to worry! I've got a plan.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Gimme one second. I'll send you all my secret weapon.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <This looks like...a template for a greeting card?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <We just gotta print a bunch, write individualized messages for everyone, fold along the lines and voila! Fancy invitations!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Wow... I didn't know things like this existed...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Not only that, the site for the link I just sent has templates that you can write and send messages directly to anyone.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Ichika, didn't you say there's someone at Kamiyama High that you were hoping to invite?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Yes. Oh, so this site would allow me to invite her without having to arrange a meeting in advance.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Actually, I might just do the same since I'll be inviting Mizuki and Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <However, I'm not very good at decorating this kind of thing... I don't know how to make them look good...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<I know the feeling.
You need to have like a sixth sense...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Hey, hold up.
Why do you think we're having this call?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I know just how to gussy up this template!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <When I was still in junior high, there was a point where I got so busy with work that I hardly even had time to go to school...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <So I didn't have time to buy birthday presents for my friends and stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But I still wanted to celebrate somehow, so I decided to try using these.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <It meant that, in addition to birthdays, I had a backup plan for Christmas, Valentine's Day and other holidays.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (To be fair, it wasn't the perfect backup plan since I sometimes didn't even have time to write and send people messages...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But...it's nice that I'm able to put my past experiences to good use like this.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Oh, Airi, does this mean there are a lot of tools for decorating these templates?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Which means you don't need to have a sixth sense for designing things. These tools make it really easy to create really nice greeting cards!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you very much. This helps quite a lot...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Don't thank me just yet.
First, let me show you all a few simple tricks!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Starting with these animated stamps! These can help make your template more fun since they're so cute and goofy!>
